title: Personal site block catalog

story.need: compose a complete modern personal site from proven semantic patterns
story.outcome: new pages reuse governed blocks instead of deriving presentation from first principles

scope: Add statistics, testimonial, logo cloud, project grid, and contact blocks
Render every block in editors, previews, public pages, and MCP schemas
Use licensed Tailwind Plus patterns as private structural design input
dataRequirements: Every block has a stable ID, type, version, and validated data
All links use the safe-link policy
permissions: Only authenticated editors may change block drafts
Anonymous visitors read published blocks only

acceptanceCriteria.when: an editor or MCP client discovers it
then: all personal-site block types and purposes are present
default values pass the shared schema

acceptanceCriteria.given: a page containing each supported block
then: every block has an accessible responsive renderer
